ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION I. Title 17 of the Municipal Code, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,

be amended by changing all the RS3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House)

District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 9-H in the area bounded by
West Grace Street; a line 27.17 ft. east of and parallel to North Leavitt
Street; next the Public Alley south of and parallel to West Grace Street;
and North Leavitt Street

to those of the B1-1 Neighborhood Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and

due publication.

Common Address of Property: 3753 N. Leavitt Street/2157 W. Grace Street
